# Transcription

**Document type:** Property-maintenance photographic record (PDF, 1 page). The image placeholder is a neutral text box, so no actual photograph is embedded.

## Full text, as written

**Northbridge Lettings**

**Photograph of a solar photovoltaic generation meter**

Photographic record of the solar panel reading for Flat 10, 180 Alder Lane, Cedarford, ZZ3 4ZZ.

Single Phase Watt Meter
1000 imp/kWh
Solar PV System Point of emergency switching
I ON
Juniper Utilities

**Observations**
- The meter's digital display appears to show 16845.
- The meter is fitted with a red rotary isolator; its position is marked I ON.
- A yellow warning label identifies the switch as the solar PV system emergency switching point.

**Findings**
- The photograph records a reading on a single-phase watt meter associated with a solar PV system.

**Conclusions**
- The image serves as a photographic record of the solar panel meter reading.

**Image evidence**

*Neutral image placeholder*
Meter at Flat 10, 180 Alder Lane, Cedarford, ZZ3 4ZZ; the display appears to read 16845, with a solar PV emergency-switching warning and the red isolator marked I ON.

## Key details

| Item | Value as written |
|---|---|
| Company / author | Northbridge Lettings |
| Utility name on meter | Juniper Utilities |
| Property | Flat 10, 180 Alder Lane, Cedarford, ZZ3 4ZZ |
| Meter type | Single Phase Watt Meter |
| Meter constant | 1000 imp/kWh |
| Display reading | 16845 (stated as "appears to show/read") |
| Isolator | Red rotary isolator, position marked "I ON" |
| Label | Yellow warning label: Solar PV System Point of emergency switching |

## Unclear, missing or inconsistent

- **No date or time** of the reading or photograph.
- **No author, inspector or reference number** is given.
- **No meter serial number or MPAN/MPRN**, so the meter cannot be matched to an account.
- **No units are shown with the reading.** 16845 is presumably kWh, but the document does not say so. It also gives no decimal places, and it is unclear whether a final digit is a decimal.
- **The reading is hedged.** The document says "appears to" in both places, so it is not confirmed.
- **No actual photograph** is included, only a text placeholder, so the reading and isolator position cannot be checked visually.
- **No previous reading** is given for comparison, so no generation figure can be derived.
- **No condition or fault notes**, and no confirmation that the system is generating.
- The relationship between Northbridge Lettings and Juniper Utilities is not stated. Juniper Utilities appears only as text on the meter.

input.body:
Dear Landlord,

Re: Flat 10, 180 Alder Lane, Cedarford, ZZ3 4ZZ – Ref R/PM010-1

As part of the quarterly solar panel readings, the tenant sent us a photographic record of the solar PV generation meter on 17 January 2025.

- Meter: Single Phase Watt Meter (1000 imp/kWh), Juniper Utilities
- Display reading: 16845 (the record shows no units; this is presumably kWh)
- The PV emergency isolator is shown in the ON position

The record has no date or meter serial number on it. Please let us know if you need anything else for this reading, such as a clearer photo or the meter serial number, and we will ask the tenant. We will request the next reading when it is due.

Kind regards,
Donna
Northbridge Lettings
